description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects the official Cloudflare Code Mode MCP server: the model gets search + execute over 2,500+ Cloudflare API endpoints (Workers, DNS, R2, KV, D1, Pages, Zero Trust), with a visual settings panel for OAuth 2.1 or API token authentication.
description.zh-cn: 把 Cloudflare 官方 Code Mode MCP 接入 DeepSeek Harness：AI 通过 search / execute 两个工具访问 2,500+ Cloudflare API（Workers、DNS、R2、KV、D1、Pages、Zero Trust），并附带 OAuth 2.1 / API Token 双认证的可视化设置面板。

title.zh-cn: 无 DSH 运行时依赖

description.en: Connect Cloudflare's official Code Mode MCP to DeepSeek Harness. The model gets two tools — search (query the full OpenAPI spec) and execute (run cloudflare.request()) — covering 2,500+ endpoints across every Cloudflare product: Workers, Pages, DNS, R2, KV, D1, Zero Trust, AI Gateway and more. A localhost proxy injects credentials per request, so tokens never enter profile config and changes apply without restarting. Settings panel supports OAuth 2.1 (PKCE + dynamic client registration) and API tokens; credentials stay on this machine at ~/.dsh/dsh-cloudflare-codemode.json.
description.zh-cn: 把 Cloudflare 官方 Code Mode MCP 接入 DeepSeek Harness。模型获得两个工具：search（检索完整 OpenAPI 规格）与 execute（执行 cloudflare.request()），覆盖 Workers、Pages、DNS、R2、KV、D1、Zero Trust、AI Gateway 等全部产品的 2,500+ 端点。本机代理逐请求注入凭据，Token 不写入 profile 配置、改动无需重启。设置面板支持 OAuth 2.1（PKCE + 动态客户端注册）与 API Token，凭据只存本机 ~/.dsh/dsh-cloudflare-codemode.json。
